purpose: Development pilot of Analytic Unconditional Guidance before any frozen test: inside the teacher-guided handover window, can the unconditional half of classifier-free guidance be computed in closed form instead of by the network, with the teacher's handovers keeping quality and pitch variety
theory: flow matching x_t = (1 - t) eps + t x1: the best unconditional velocity is (E[x1 | x_t] - x_t) / (1 - t); at t = 0 the state is independent of x1, so E[x1 | x_0] = E[x1] = mu and v_u = mu - x exactly; for small t, E[x1 | x_t] = mu + O(t). The teacher hands over at Step 4 (t = 0.0761) or Step 8 (t = 0.2929), so it only runs while the signal is weak.

algorithm.teacher: the released guided Euler teacher on the 16-interval sway grid (sampler.run_teacher_single_pass, CFG_STRENGTH), except that at Steps 0..K the unconditional evaluation is replaced by v_u = (mu - x_i) / (1 - t_i)
algorithm.mu: per mel band, the network's own unconditional endpoint estimate at t = 0 (x + v_u(x, 0)) for each case's initial noise, pooled over every frame of the clean-prompt cases at Quick-set positions 41-60 (speakers the pilot does not use), computed once at the start of the run (calibration.json)
algorithm.student: the released student loop at j = 1 from the teacher's endpoint estimate, unchanged

data.pilot: the first 40 EXP-012 Quick-set development speakers x ['clean', 'noisy15'] (80 cases), synthesis seed = input seed; quality is scored for W4_K and W8_K on clean prompts and W8_K on noisy15
data.calibration: Quick-set positions 41-60, clean prompts, input seed, teacher's unconditional branch at t = 0 only
data.diversity: the first 10 speakers x clean x 20 seeds (input_seed + 1000 + m), the four AUG handovers; the released Step-4 handover is re-synthesized for the first speaker to check reproduction of EXP-020's stored CVf0
data.timing: the first 10 speakers, clean, 3 repeats in alternating order after one warm-up
data.reused: the released teacher's Step-4 and Step-8 handovers (EXP-018, same cases and seeds) and their clean-prompt CVf0 (EXP-020 plain_4 and plain_8, same speakers and seeds)

diagnostic.closed_form_gap: per step 0-8 on the released trajectory: ||mu - T_u|| / ||T_c - T_u|| on generated frames
diagnostic.step0_split: 3 further noise draws (seed + 3000 + j) of the same shape: seed-specific part ||T_u - mean_j T_u^(j)|| and position part ||mean_j T_u^(j) - mu||, same units
diagnostic.estimate_change: relative change of the Step-4 and Step-8 estimates (whole and 9-frame slow part) under AUG K = 0, 2, 4, next to the change from refining the grid to 32 intervals at the same sway time

hardware: Colab Tesla T4 only; Shonget-DMOSpeech2 at the pinned commit
smoke: must reproduce the stored W4 and W8 scores (EXP-018, tolerance 0.01), match the released guided teacher with this runner's loop and with AUG switched off (K = -1), max abs difference <= 0.0001 for both

criteria.quality_clean: for each K in (2, 4): W4_K and W8_K against the released W4 and W8 of the same case and seed, clean prompts: capped-WER difference upper 95% bound <= the bound, similarity lower bound >= -0.01, UTMOS lower bound >= -0.10 (bounds above; speaker bootstrap)
criteria.pitch_variety: for each K in (2, 4): mean CVf0 of W4_K and of W8_K minus EXP-020's stored CVf0 of the released handover at the same step, over the 10 diversity speakers, both >= -0.01
criteria.quality_noisy_reference: for each K in (2, 4): W8_K against the released W8 on noisy15 with the bounds above (secondary)

decision_rule: advance AUG to a frozen test on new speakers only if, for some K, quality_clean and pitch_variety both hold; the K carried forward is the largest that does (the cheapest); quality_noisy_reference at that K decides whether the frozen test also covers noisy-prompt teacher runs; otherwise report a negative pilot, with no retuning on these data

power_check.proxy: 16-interval grid (g16_k) against the 32-interval grid at the same sway time (g32_2k), EXP-018 stored outputs of the 60 Quick-set development speakers; k = 7 stands in for Step 8
power_check.summary: with 40 speakers the 16- vs 32-interval grid change passes the clean Step-4 bounds in 100% of 300 subsets (UTMOS 69% with 20 speakers); at Step 7 the clean WER bound +0.01 passes 33%, +0.015 passes 100%; on noisy15 the same grid change passes all noisy bounds in 0% (Step 4) and 2% (Step 7) of subsets, because it moves similarity itself, so noisy-prompt Step-4 handovers are not judged and the noisy-prompt reference criterion is secondary: a failure there does not show that AUG is worse than a grid change

descriptive: the closed-form gap per step and condition, and its Step-0 split
estimate changes under K = 0, 2, 4 next to the grid change
Definition 3.1 failures against the released output of the same step and against the reference
the released W4's CVf0 reproduction for the first diversity speaker
T4 time per arm and its ratio to the pass ratio
evidence_status: development pilot on speakers that designed earlier experiments; not evidence for a claim
novelty: family-level searches on 2026-11-14 found no method that keeps the conditional pass and computes classifier-free guidance's unconditional term in closed form. Closest, all different: Lite-CFG (DC-DiT, fewer tokens in the unconditional pass, trained multi-budget model), Path-Drop Guidance (SPRINT, unconditional pass skips middle blocks, trained architecture), the guidance interval (guidance switched off at high noise), CFG-Zero* (zeroes the first steps), independent-condition and time-step guidance (still a network pass), Gaussian analytical teleportation (Wang and Vastola, skips early steps with the whole model), and analyses of CFG in Gaussian or linear settings (no sampling shortcut; the 2026 one's sampler still runs the unconditional pass). The theory (Gaussian structure at high noise) is known; not a full literature review.
adoption: not adopted; changing the thesis method needs a dated decision record and adviser review
